hooks.command:
# Prevent editing on main branch
[ "$(git branch --show-current)" != "main" ] || { echo '{"block": true, "message": "Cannot edit files on main branch. Create a feature branch first."}' >&2; exit 2; }

# Auto-format JS/TS files with Prettier (or Biome)
case "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" in
  *.js|*.jsx|*.ts|*.tsx)
    # Use prettier (swap for biome if preferred)
    npx prettier --write "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" 2>&1
    if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
      echo '{"feedback": "Formatting failed. Check file for syntax errors."}' >&2
      exit 1
    else
      echo '{"feedback": "Formatting applied.", "suppressOutput": true}'
    fi
    ;;
esac

# Auto-install dependencies when package.json changes
case "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" in
  *package.json)
    echo '{"feedback": "Installing dependencies..."}' >&2
    if npm install >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      echo '{"feedback": "Dependencies installed.", "suppressOutput": true}'
    else
      echo '{"feedback": "Failed to install dependencies."}' >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    ;;
esac

# Auto-run tests when test files change
case "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" in
  *.test.js|*.test.jsx|*.test.ts|*.test.tsx)
    echo '{"feedback": "Running tests..."}' >&2
    output=$(npm test -- --findRelatedTests "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" --passWithNoTests 2>&1)
    exit_code=$?
    echo "$output" | tail -30
    if [ $exit_code -eq 0 ]; then
      echo '{"feedback": "Tests passed."}'
    else
      echo '{"feedback": "Tests failed. See output above."}' >&2
    fi
    ;;
esac

# Type-check TypeScript files
case "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" in
  *.ts|*.tsx)
    echo '{"feedback": "Checking TypeScript types..."}' >&2
    output=$(npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1)
    exit_code=$?
    if [ $exit_code -eq 0 ]; then
      echo '{"feedback": "No TypeScript errors.", "suppressOutput": true}'
    else
      errors=$(echo "$output" | grep -A 2 "error TS" | head -30)
      if [ -n "$errors" ]; then
        echo '{"feedback": "TypeScript found type errors:"}' >&2
        echo "$errors" >&2
      fi
    fi
    # Non-blocking
    exit 0
    ;;
esac
